utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday again. Can you all hear me? Right, let's do nights first, then what's actually on the list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Traffic on the ring road was absolutely solid. I've spent longer looking at the same van than I have at this screen.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Lovely start. We were making weekend plans yesterday, thinking we'd get out walking next weekend. Seen the weather now, though. Probably another weekend indoors.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: At least indoors might have coffee. The broken coffee machine in the canteen is still doing its impression of a very expensive cupboard.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: So morale's excellent, then.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Outstanding. And that's a complaint, not me volunteering to repair it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Noted. Olu, anything carried over from last night?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, so, finished the repair on the GT1 fuel valve last night. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fully finished, not one of those 'done apart from' ones?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Fully finished. Nothing left on that repair.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Same from me: finished the repair on the GT1 compressor last night. That's closed as well.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good. Neither of those needs carrying onto today's list.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Exactly, just reporting it back.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: One thing from nights, I noticed the desiccant unit was running a bit warm, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Settled while you were there, you mean? Not still warm when you left?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, settled while I was there. Just an observation, not raising a job for it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And we're still waiting on parts for the booster pump. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, that stays blocked, then. No new action against it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's it. Same position, unfortunately.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Jamie, can you chase the purchase order for the CV01 today? Low priority, but today.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Sorry, I can't take that today. I'm not going to promise it and then leave it sitting there.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fair enough. Boss, can you take that instead—chase the purchase order for the CV01 today? Still low priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it off Jamie. I'll chase the purchase order for the CV01 today, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Cheers, boss. So I haven't got a parallel chase on that, then.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Correct, just boss on the CV01 purchase order. Today, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, mine.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: While we're on parts, I'll go to the treatment plant to pick up the replacement parts for the IM1 hydraulic unit by Wednesday. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Thanks, Olu. By Wednesday for the collection, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah. I'll pick them up from the treatment plant by Wednesday. I'm not including fitting them in that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Right, useful distinction. Replacement parts coming back, not a completed repair.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Exactly. It's urgent, but by Wednesday is the deadline for that pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Understood. That's with Olu.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, someone's gone a bit Dalek. Is it just me?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Might be my headset. How's that?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, you're back. Much less threatening.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Um, I'll order spare parts for the stacker tomorrow morning. No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Cheers, Pricey. That's the spare parts order, just to keep it separate from the other bits.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, the order. I'll do that tomorrow morning, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And that's separate from the CV01 purchase order chase. Two different things, before we muddle them together.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, mine's spare parts for the stacker.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Pricey, can you also clear the jam and check the sensors on the spinner? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the spinner. I'll take that.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—both bits, the jam and the sensor checks?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Both, yeah. Not just clear it and call it finished.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Exactly. It matters but it's not urgent, so don't read that as an emergency call-out.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Understood. Important, not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team next week. No rush on that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Thanks, Aisha. Next week for the toolbox talk, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, I'll organise it. That's mine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: A toolbox talk where Teams doesn't eat every third word would be a novelty.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Let's not set expectations too high, boss.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Same approach I'm taking with those weekend plans. Expect rain, be pleasantly surprised.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I expected coffee and was unpleasantly surprised, so your system's probably better.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the breakfast complaints channel, quick check of what we've actually agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I've got the CV01 purchase order chase instead of Jamie. Today, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I'll go to the treatment plant for the replacement parts for the IM1 hydraulic unit by Wednesday. It's urgent. Collection only.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'll order spare parts for the stacker tomorrow morning, no rush. And I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the spinner—it matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team next week. No rush.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good. The booster pump hasn't suddenly become another action in that lot; it's still waiting on parts.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Blocked until they arrive, nothing we can do in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And the GT1 fuel valve and GT1 compressor repairs are finished, not being handed out again.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Desiccant unit was only an observation as well. It settled down, so nothing new from me there.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And no coffee machine job. Just a factory-wide sense of loss.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Tragic. Right, that's us. Cheers, everyone.
